{{Youmay|proximity sensors|[[proximity indicator]]s}}
A '''proximity sensor''' can refer to one of two types of [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]], designed to detect:

#high-[[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] fields. Such sensors were in [[Starship/Legends|starships]] around [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]] to inform [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] of the location of any such fields in their area that might prevent the use of their [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]].<ref name="Outbound Flight novel">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]</ref>
#physical objects. Such a sensor could be used to open a door automatically when someone approached.<ref name="MedStar II: Jedi Healer">''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]'' {{C|page 291}}</ref>
